answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the garden release is recorded with every signature, the forge audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the beacon graph and each risks its bond. The fee repeats 24 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
